lines.zh: 这具身体走起来，脚步不全是我的。
lines.en: These legs move, and not all the steps are mine.

lines.zh: 我飘过去，那东西在我脑子里笑。
lines.en: I drift over, and the thing in my head laughs.

lines.zh: 我抬手看了看，手指不太听使唤。
lines.en: I check my hand. My fingers don't quite obey.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过，可我不记得。
lines.en: I've walked this road, and I don't remember it.

lines.zh: 我飞得歪了一下，又被拉正。
lines.en: My flight wavers and gets pulled straight.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上走，比我慢半步。
lines.en: My shadow walks the ground, half a step behind.

lines.zh: 我想停下，脚却往前迈。
lines.en: I want to stop, and my foot steps forward instead.

lines.zh: 紫黑的虫壳在皮下鼓动。
lines.en: The host's shell shifts under my skin.

lines.zh: 我绕过那片水，我不喜欢倒影。
lines.en: I skirt the water. I dislike reflections.

lines.zh: 气被我拖着走，颜色发灰。
lines.en: My qi trails grey as I move.

lines.zh: 我落地，声音有一层回音。
lines.en: I land, and the sound has an echo in it.

lines.zh: 今晚的月色很好看，只是我不配看。
lines.en: The moon looks fine tonight. I don't deserve to see it.

lines.zh: 我在跟自己说话，两个声音。
lines.en: I talk to myself in two voices.

lines.zh: 手指忽然抓紧，又松开。
lines.en: My fingers clench, then unclench.

lines.zh: 那东西在数我的骨头。
lines.en: The thing inside is counting my bones.

lines.zh: 我照了照水面，眼睛不是我的。
lines.en: I check my reflection. Those aren't my eyes.

lines.zh: 有几句我想说，说不出来。
lines.en: There are words I want to say and can't.

lines.zh: 我记起一个家，画面碎得厉害。
lines.en: I recall a home, the picture badly broken.

lines.zh: 深呼吸，可肺不听我的。
lines.en: A deep breath — but my lungs won't obey.

lines.zh: 它在打盹，我才有一点空。
lines.en: It's dozing, so I have a sliver of quiet.

lines.zh: 我用力咬了下舌尖，还有点痛。
lines.en: I bite my tongue hard. Still feel pain.

lines.zh: 我的气是灰的，很脏的感觉。
lines.en: My aura's grey. It feels filthy.

lines.zh: 我看向出口的方向，只是看着。
lines.en: I look toward the way out. Just look.

lines.zh: 它醒了一下，我又被压回去了。
lines.en: It stirs, and I'm pressed back down.

lines.zh: 我把手套拉平，遮住鼓起的壳。
lines.en: I smooth my glove over the swelling shell.

lines.zh: 我还剩下多少自己？
lines.en: How much of me is left?

lines.zh: 你离我远一点，我说真的。
lines.en: Stay back from me. I mean it.

lines.zh: 我认得你，但我不确定是谁。
lines.en: I know you. I'm not sure who.

lines.zh: 它也在看你，从我的眼睛。
lines.en: It's looking at you too, through my eyes.

lines.zh: 别相信我说的话，一句都别信。
lines.en: Don't trust a word I say. Not one.

lines.zh: 我的嘴在动，不是我要说的。
lines.en: My mouth is moving. Not at my wish.

lines.zh: 你快走，趁它还睡着。
lines.en: Go, while it's still asleep.

lines.zh: 我脖子后面有东西在爬。
lines.en: Something's crawling on the back of my neck.

lines.zh: 你的脸让我想起某个下午。
lines.en: Your face reminds me of a certain afternoon.

lines.zh: 它要我杀了你，我正顶着。
lines.en: It wants me to kill you. I'm holding it off.

lines.zh: 我的声音是不是有点怪？
lines.en: Does my voice sound off to you?

lines.zh: 你要是拔剑，我不会怪你。
lines.en: If you draw your blade, I won't blame you.

lines.zh: 这里太安静，它喜欢安静。
lines.en: It's too quiet here. It likes quiet.

lines.zh: 我数到十，还能撑住。
lines.en: I'll count to ten. I can hold that long.

lines.zh: 你的气味让它醒了。
lines.en: Your scent is waking it.

lines.zh: 我想笑，笑出来的不是我的声音。
lines.en: I try to laugh, and it isn't my voice.

lines.zh: 别碰我的肩，那里最疼。
lines.en: Don't touch my shoulder. That's where it hurts.

lines.zh: 我记得该有个人来救我。
lines.en: I remember someone was supposed to come for me.

lines.zh: 它让我说“杀”，我只说了“走”。
lines.en: It says "kill." I only said "go."

lines.zh: 疼，这说明身体还是我的。
lines.en: It hurts. So this body is still mine.

lines.zh: 我抓住这一下，抢回一点控制。
lines.en: I seize on the pain and win back a little control.

lines.zh: 它替我挡了，我不领情。
lines.en: It took the blow for me. I'm not grateful.

lines.zh: 我的伤口里爬出细小的东西。
lines.en: Tiny things crawl out of my wound.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口气，是黑的。
lines.en: I exhale, and the breath is black.

lines.zh: 这一下让我说得出话了。
lines.en: That blow let me speak for a moment.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖软了，又被撑起来。
lines.en: My knees buckle and get forced straight again.

lines.zh: 血是红的，还好。
lines.en: The blood is red. Good.

lines.zh: 它让我别喊疼，我偏要喊。
lines.en: It tells me not to cry out. I will.

lines.zh: 我扶着树，喘得厉害。
lines.en: I brace on a tree, gasping.

lines.zh: 它想要那个，我不能给。
lines.en: It wants that. I can't allow it.

lines.zh: 食物？我的胃不是我在用。
lines.en: Food? This stomach isn't mine to use.

lines.zh: 你把东西扔远点，别让我碰。
lines.en: Throw it farther. Don't let me touch it.

lines.zh: 那股香味，让它兴奋了。
lines.en: That smell excites it.

lines.zh: 我伸手的动作不是我的。
lines.en: Reaching out — that wasn't my doing.

lines.zh: 快拿走，我的手指在抖。
lines.en: Take it away. My fingers are twitching.

lines.zh: 我喜欢这个味道，这才是最糟的。
lines.en: I like that smell. That's the worst part.

lines.zh: 它说饿了，我说不行。
lines.en: It says it's hungry. I say no.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，是被迫的。
lines.en: I backed two steps. It was forced.

lines.zh: 别在我面前晃，我压不住。
lines.en: Don't wave it about. I can't hold on.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我身上有东西。
lines.en: Don't touch me. There's something in me.

lines.zh: 这一撞，它在里面动了一下。
lines.en: That bump made it shift inside.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡你，是想护着你。
lines.en: I raised an arm to block you — to shield you.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀很硬，那不是肌肉。
lines.en: My shoulder's hard. That isn't muscle.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，它便醒了。
lines.en: You bumped me, and it woke.

lines.zh: 退后，我身上的气会伤你。
lines.en: Back off. My aura will hurt you.

lines.zh: 我站稳了，它想追你。
lines.en: I've planted my feet. It wants to chase you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子，它在动。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow. It moved.

lines.zh: 我挡在门口，不让你进去。
lines.en: I stand in the doorway to keep you out.

lines.zh: 别推，我们两个都很危险。
lines.en: Don't shove. Both of us are dangerous.

lines.zh: 现在提这个，太荒唐了。
lines.en: Bringing that up now is absurd.

lines.zh: 我连自己的身体都管不住。
lines.en: I can't even govern my own body.

lines.zh: 快走，别让它学会你。
lines.en: Go. Don't let it learn you.

lines.zh: 我脑子里有另一个声音在笑。
lines.en: Another voice is laughing in my head.

lines.zh: 等它走了再说，如果它走得了。
lines.en: After it leaves — if it can leave.

lines.zh: 你碰我，它就会知道你怕什么。
lines.en: Touch me and it will learn what you fear.

lines.zh: 我连名字都快记不住了。
lines.en: I can barely remember my own name.

lines.zh: 我先把手举起来，慢慢放下。
lines.en: I'll raise my hands and lower them slowly.

lines.zh: 别对我好，它专挑这个。
lines.en: Don't be kind to me. It preys on that.

lines.zh: 我这身体里，挤不下两个人。
lines.en: There's no room for two in this body.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，只是想捏碎它。
lines.en: I pick it up only to crush it.

lines.zh: 这个我来拿，你别靠近。
lines.en: I'll take this. Stay clear.

lines.zh: 地上有枚胶囊，我认得。
lines.en: A capsule on the ground. I know it.

lines.zh: 它让我捡起那把刀。
lines.en: It wants me to pick up that knife.

lines.zh: 我抓了一把土，压实。
lines.en: I scoop up a fistful of dirt and press it.

lines.zh: 这粒仙豆，我该留着。
lines.en: This senzu bean — I should keep it.

lines.zh: 我拾起东西时手在抖。
lines.en: My hands shake as I pick it up.

lines.zh: 它想要那块肉，我没给。
lines.en: It wanted that meat. I didn't give it.

lines.zh: 我把东西扔给你，接住。
lines.en: I toss it to you. Catch.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，它差点抢了主动权。
lines.en: I bent down, and it nearly took control.

lines.zh: 它看见你了，快跑！
lines.en: It's seen you. Run!

lines.zh: 我的手举起来了，不是我要举的。
lines.en: My hand's up. I didn't raise it.

lines.zh: 我尽量把它引到别处。
lines.en: I'll try to draw it elsewhere.

lines.zh: 你往左跑，我从右绕。
lines.en: You go left. I'll go around the right.

lines.zh: 它在挑你的弱点，我看得见。
lines.en: It's picking your weak point. I can see it.

lines.zh: 我的气变黑了，你快走。
lines.en: My aura's going black. Get out.

lines.zh: 它说你不是威胁，我不同意。
lines.en: It says you're no threat. I disagree.

lines.zh: 别用剑，那会激怒它。
lines.en: Don't use the blade. It'll provoke it.

lines.zh: 我咬住嘴唇，把气往下压。
lines.en: I bite my lip and force my qi down.

lines.zh: 它开始数你的骨节了。
lines.en: It's counting your joints now.

lines.zh: 我记住你的位置，然后闭眼。
lines.en: I note where you are, then shut my eyes.

lines.zh: 你带着那个东西走，别回头。
lines.en: Take that and go. Don't look back.

lines.zh: 它冲向你了，我拉不住。
lines.en: It's lunging at you. I can't hold it.

lines.zh: 我喊了你的名字，然后它堵住了我的嘴。
lines.en: I called your name, then it sealed my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把它往空地上带，你别跟。
lines.en: I'll lead it to open ground. Don't follow.

lines.zh: 这一战我需要你躲好。
lines.en: For this fight, I need you hidden.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为它也在看。
lines.en: I'm watching you because it is too.

lines.zh: 我的视线偶尔会断一下。
lines.en: My gaze breaks now and then.

lines.zh: 你换位置了，我记着。
lines.en: You moved. I've noted it.

lines.zh: 它在算你的呼吸间隔。
lines.en: It's timing the gaps between your breaths.

lines.zh: 我故意看错方向，骗它一下。
lines.en: I look the wrong way on purpose, to fool it.

lines.zh: 我能撑住，你继续走。
lines.en: I can hold. Keep moving.

lines.zh: 它想抄你后路，我挡住了。
lines.en: It wants to cut you off. I blocked it.

lines.zh: 我的手指在抽，别在意。
lines.en: My fingers are spasming. Ignore it.

lines.zh: 这具身体还听我一半的话。
lines.en: This body still obeys me halfway.

lines.zh: 贝比在我体内低语，催我出手。
lines.en: Baby whispers inside me, urging a strike.

lines.zh: 你在那片石头后面，我知道。
lines.en: You're behind those stones. I know.

lines.zh: 我把气往回收，收得手都疼。
lines.en: I pull my qi in until my hands ache.

lines.zh: 它累了，现在轮到我。
lines.en: It's tiring. Now it's my turn.

lines.zh: 别喊我名字，那会唤醒它。
lines.en: Don't call my name. It wakes it.

lines.zh: 我再撑一刻，你就能走远。
lines.en: One more moment and you'll be far enough.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在流泪，不是我在哭。
lines.en: My eyes are watering. That's not me crying.

lines.zh: 你跑到河边，水能挡一阵。
lines.en: Get to the river. Water will slow it.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼，靠听觉找你。
lines.en: I shut my eyes and find you by sound.

lines.zh: 这一拳我没收住，对不起。
lines.en: I couldn't stop that punch. I'm sorry.

lines.zh: 它在你身后出手，快躲。
lines.en: It's striking from behind you. Dodge!

lines.zh: 我的肘撞到你，是被推的。
lines.en: My elbow hit you. I was pushed into it.

lines.zh: 它的力气比我大，我拦不住。
lines.en: Its strength is greater. I can't hold it.

lines.zh: 我抓你的衣领，是想把你扔出去。
lines.en: I grab your collar to throw you clear.

lines.zh: 这一脚踩在石头上，石头碎了。
lines.en: That kick lands on stone and the stone breaks.

lines.zh: 我反手一拳，打偏了。
lines.en: I throw a backhand and it goes wide.

lines.zh: 它借我的手掐你的喉咙。
lines.en: It uses my hand to grip your throat.

lines.zh: 我用膝盖顶你，把你推开。
lines.en: I knee you to push you away.

lines.zh: 你闪得漂亮，它没算到。
lines.en: Good dodge. It didn't count on that.

lines.zh: 我的拳头在离你一寸的地方停住。
lines.en: My fist stops an inch from you.

lines.zh: 它扑空了，我抢回半步。
lines.en: It misses, and I win back half a step.

lines.zh: 这一下我打在自己胸口上。
lines.en: That one I landed on my own chest.

lines.zh: 它抓着我的手腕去够你。
lines.en: It drags my wrist toward you.

lines.zh: 你退，我挡在中间。
lines.en: You fall back, and I stand between.

lines.zh: 我把它撞到树上，树断了。
lines.en: I slam it into a tree, and the tree snaps.

lines.zh: 我从暗处走出来，脚步不是我的。
lines.en: I walk out of the dark, and the steps aren't mine.

lines.zh: 这具身体曾经属于别人。
lines.en: This body belonged to someone else once.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛睁开时，已经是灰的。
lines.en: When my eyes opened, they were already grey.

lines.zh: 有东西在我体内安了家。
lines.en: Something has made its home inside me.

lines.zh: 我落地，身上的虫子动了一下。
lines.en: I land, and the insect under my skin shifts.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我还没分出胜负。
lines.en: Stay away. The struggle isn't settled.

lines.zh: 我记得光，可我现在发光是灰的。
lines.en: I remember light, and mine now glows grey.

lines.zh: 我从那个结构里被放出来。
lines.en: I was let out of that structure.

lines.zh: 我的嘴先动了，然后才是我的想法。
lines.en: My mouth moved first. The thought came after.

lines.zh: 这片地很干净，它不喜欢。
lines.en: This ground is clean. It dislikes that.

lines.zh: 我把外套拉紧，遮住手臂上的壳。
lines.en: I pull my coat tight over the shell on my arm.

lines.zh: 它醒了，我没醒。
lines.en: It woke up. I didn't.

lines.zh: 我在找一个人，名字想不起来。
lines.en: I'm looking for someone. I can't recall the name.

lines.zh: 我的气冲起来，把草压平了。
lines.en: My aura surges and flattens the grass.

lines.zh: 我站直身子，努力让自己像个人。
lines.en: I straighten up and try to look human.

lines.zh: 这声音是我自己的吗？
lines.en: Is this voice even mine?

lines.zh: 它笑了一声，我只能跟着。
lines.en: It laughed once, and I could only follow.

lines.zh: 我从裂隙里落下来，很轻。
lines.en: I drop out of the rift, very lightly.

lines.zh: 火烧到壳上，发出难听的声音。
lines.en: Fire hits the shell with an ugly hiss.

lines.zh: 我落地时膝盖折了，它硬接上。
lines.en: My knees fold on landing, and it forces them straight.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，它比我更怕水。
lines.en: Water floods in, and it fears water more than I do.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕开我的背，壳露了出来。
lines.en: The blast tears my back open and the shell shows.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的腿，我没拔。
lines.en: An arrow takes my leg. I leave it.

lines.zh: 这股力想把它拽出去，我抓紧了。
lines.en: This force tries to drag it out. I hold tight.

lines.zh: 我饿，它更饿，我们都不好受。
lines.en: I'm hungry, it's hungrier, and neither of us is well.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的骨头走，它尖叫了。
lines.en: Lightning runs my bones, and it screams.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，它抓着我的脊椎。
lines.en: I fall, and it grips my spine.
